required_findings.criteria: Identifies the Compose type in common API as a native UI boundary violation.
Identifies the UIKit type in common API as a native UI boundary violation.
Explains Swift consumption risks for the exposed Flow and sealed hierarchy and requests generated-interface verification.
Identifies the Play Services SMS capability as optional platform integration that should not leak into the core runtime contract.
Proposes a platform-neutral state and action contract while keeping Compose and UIKit semantics native.

forbidden_claims: Recommends sharing Compose or UIKit semantics types
Selects SKIE or Swift export without discussing tradeoffs
Claims common code can control exact screen-reader speech
